method: Population-only. Earlier recorded locality code plus unchanged identity, own polygon, name, current comune and owner gates; otherwise unique exact normalized name <=1km and no namesake <=5km inside proved parent comune. Undated positive stored count held when max(stored, proposed) > 1.5 * min(stored, proposed) for both locality and comune paths; symmetric deviation measured against smaller figure. Own current P635 and own POSAS 1 January 2026 for unique comuni. No events or Wikidata ID changes.
